skills: Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, DAX, Pandas, NumPy, Azure, Kubernetes, ETL, Data Analysis
full_description: At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst The opportunity In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence. A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value. Your Key Responsibilities The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations. The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing. Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation. Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting. Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including: Workflow execution metrics OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends Drift detection signals ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including: Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management Storage and compute provisioning concepts Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources. Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting. Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources. Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources. Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks: Python (pandas, NumPy, requests) PowerShell Bash Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences. Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones. To qualify for the role, you must have experience with Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years. Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years. ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years. SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years. KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services. Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent). Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces. Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms. Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis. Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics. OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting. Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis. Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data. Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI). Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years. PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection. Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery. Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred). Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred). Ideally, you'll also have Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired). Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired). Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have). ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have). Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data. Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs. Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis. Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment. What We Look For A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale. What We Offer We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer: Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Scenario analyses and decision support for sourcing and planning. Measurement and validation of savings and strategic initiatives. Qualifications And Experience Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, economics, supply chain, analytics or a related field; postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Strong capability in reporting and data analysis; experience with SQL, ERP systems or data platforms is preferred. Experience working with procurement, commodity, manufacturing or steel-related data is an advantage. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate analysis to deadlines. Skills and attributes Strong analytical thinking and attention to data quality. Ability to explain complex findings in clear, practical business language. Structured problem-solving and sound judgment. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. Collaborative approach and comfort working across functions, geographies and levels. Discretion when handling commercial, supplier and cost information. full_description: About the role Destinare Services is seeking Application Security Engineers to identify, reproduce, and assess vulnerabilities in applications powered by large language models (LLMs), agents, and connected tools. You will review source code, trace data flows, assess access controls, and create reproducible tests for issues involving sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, prompt injection, and tool abuse. Candidates need relevant security experience in at least one of Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript. Responsibilities Conduct secure code reviews of LLM applications, agent frameworks, MCP servers, and connected tools. Trace data flows across files, callbacks, registries, and background jobs to find routes that bypass security controls. Assess authentication, authorisation, least privilege, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, and approval workflows. Investigate sensitive information disclosure, excessive functionality, overly broad permissions, and unsafe agent autonomy. Write reproducible exploit tests and verify that patches prevent exploitation. Use CodeQL, Semgrep, SARIF results, and manual analysis to investigate vulnerabilities, including logic and authorisation flaws. Map confirmed findings to relevant CWE categories and document clear technical evidence. Review security patches and commit history to understand root causes and assess remediation. For reviewer-level assignments, lead code reviews and validate the accuracy and clarity of findings. Requirements At least 3 years of experience in application security, secure code review, penetration testing, or vulnerability research. Reviewer-level candidates: at least 5 years of relevant experience, including leading code reviews. Strong source-to-sink data-flow reasoning and ability to explain how a security control can be bypassed. Understanding of authentication, authorisation, least privilege, tenant isolation, trust boundaries, and approval workflows. Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, especially Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency, as well as prompt injection and tool abuse. Ability to map findings to CWE categories such as CWE-200/201, CWE-532, CWE-284/285/862/863, and CWE-250/269. Experience writing reproducible tests that distinguish vulnerable behaviour from patched behaviour. Experience with CodeQL or Semgrep, reading SARIF results, and understanding the limits of pattern-based scanners. Hands-on familiarity with LLM tool calling, agents, MCP, RAG, memory, and tracing. Relevant technologies include LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs, and OpenTelemetry. Working knowledge of Docker and Git, and ability to review security patches and commit history. Clear written technical English. Relevant experience in at least one language is required: Python: Security reviews involving unsafe deserialisation, subprocess and shell tools, logging and tracing leaks, asynchronous task queues, or dependency-injected authentication in FastAPI. Go: Security reviews involving MCP and agent tool servers, os/exec and file tools, context and middleware authentication, or broadly scoped Kubernetes or cloud credentials. TypeScript/JavaScript: Security reviews involving server actions and API routes, middleware authentication gaps, client-versus-server data exposure, MCP tool scopes, or OAuth token handling. Nice to have OSWE, OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, or a similar security certification. CVE credits, bug bounty experience, or published security research. Experience with AI red-teaming or LLM evaluation. You will work across connectivity engineering, binary protocol adaptation, historical market data processing, and latency optimization. Technical Scoping: Analyze exchange specifications, assess existing platform capabilities, identify missing functionality, and estimate the development and integration effort required. Connectivity Engineering: Design and implement connectivity solutions in collaboration with infrastructure teams, covering colocation, proxies, network lines, IP addresses, multicast groups, firewall configurations, and failover mechanisms. Protocol Adaptation: Develop and adapt market data and order entry connectors to exchange-specific binary protocols, including SBE, FAST, ITCH, OUCH, Eurex ETI, EOBI, LSE native protocols, and proprietary exchange protocols. Session and Order Management: Implement and validate session handling, recovery mechanisms, throttling, and order rejection management to ensure reliable exchange communication. Market Data and Risk Parameters: Extract and interpret raw product definitions, margin rates, price limits, lot and tick tables, and position limits, providing complete and accurate information to the team responsible for data normalization. Historical Data Processing: Convert large volumes of historical exchange archives and captured market feeds into the platform's required format and validate the results against live market data. Latency Optimization: Measure system performance using hardware timestamps, compare results against exchange benchmarks and strategy requirements, and optimize host placement, network interface cards, kernel bypass settings, CPU pinning, connector execution paths, and gateway selection. Performance Documentation: Establish and document latency baselines to support ongoing operational monitoring and performance consistency. Certification and Testing: Complete exchange conformance procedures and internal certification tests, including replay testing, soak testing, order-flow scenarios, and failover validation. Operational Preparation: Develop detailed operating instructions covering exchange sessions, schedules, trading limits, startup and shutdown procedures, failure scenarios, escalation processes, and exchange contacts. Go-Live and Handover: Coordinate the first live trading activity, provide initial production support during the hypercare period, and ensure a smooth transition to the operations and trading desk teams. Continuous Improvement: Help make future exchange integrations more efficient by applying lessons learned and improving technical implementation processes. Requirements The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering fundamentals, a solid understanding of low-level systems, and the ability to work independently on complex, project-based technical integrations. Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming principles in C++. Good knowledge of Linux system internals and operating system fundamentals. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description Do you want to build custom business applications that directly support and improve how the company operates every day —from launching new capabilities to keeping critical systems stable and evolving? As Senior Developer in our Custom Business Applications team, you’ll work hands-on across an Azure full-stack to design, implement, and evolve applications that support core business processes. You’ll own complex implementations at component and module level, ensure high quality and reliability, and help keep business-critical systems stable while they continue to evolve. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys turning business requirements into robust, production-ready software, solving nontrivial technical problems, and contributing to a healthy codebase. If you want your work to have direct impact on real business operations, this role lets you see the results of your code every day. Responsibilities Technical Implementation Understand and implement solutions based on the defined LLD (low level design). Own complex implementations at component/module level. Ensure correctness, performance, security, and maintainability of delivered solutions. Make sound technical decisions within assigned scope, escalating broader design concerns as needed. Delivery & Execution Excellence Translate approved requirements and designs into working software. Break down assigned features into actionable tasks. Provide reliable estimates for owned work. Deliver high-quality increments aligned with sprint goals. Proactively resolve technical issues within assigned scope. Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices Write code that is reliable, readable, and maintainable, and follow the team’s agreed standards and best practices Participate in meaningful code reviews. Ensure adherence to DoR (Definition of Ready) and DoD (Definition of Done) criteria. Identify and address technical debt within owned components/module. You will contribute to reliable, AI-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on applying pre-trained and hosted foundation models — through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine-tuning models. This is a growth-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence. Contribute to prompt engineering (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, role-based prompting) for AI-powered workflows. Help develop and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search. Support the development of knowledge graph and Graph RAG pipelines under guidance to enable grounded, traceable responses. Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI. Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol. Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments. Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications. Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products. Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability. Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team. Required Technical Skills Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting. Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows. Hands-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques. Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search. Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship-aware retrieval. full_description: Job Title Senior Platform Engineer Job Description So, who are we? IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses. The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here. Your team This role is part of our Platform Engineering team who are responsible for building the cloud and containers platform landscape to support the business applications via self-service capabilities and automation. Your role in the Team's Success As a Senior Platform Engineer, you’ll be a hands-on technical expert who builds, improves and operates platform infrastructure that is secure, scalable, reliable and cost-effective, across our on-premises and AWS estates. You’ll bring engineering, security and FinOps best practice into platform design and delivery. You’ll contribute to complex technical decisions, reduce platform risk, and help engineering teams deliver with confidence and speed. You’ll also mentor more junior engineers and promote knowledge sharing across the team. What You'll Do Design and build scalable, secure AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and contribute to cloud technology evaluation and standardisation. Build and maintain configuration management using open-source Puppet (roles, profiles and modules with Hiera), developing reusable modules with unit testing, linting, versioning and controlled promotion across environments. Use Ansible for orchestration and automation tasks where it is the better fit. Design, build and optimise GitLab CI/CD pipelines that test, validate and deploy infrastructure and configuration changes, embedding DevOps and DevSecOps practices such as secrets management and vulnerability scanning. Manage and automate AWS EC2 and Linux estates with AWS Systems Manager (State Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager, Parameter Store and automation documents), including instance configuration, hardening and lifecycle management. Manage the certificate lifecycle across platform services, including issuance, renewal, rotation and expiry monitoring, and automate these processes to reduce outages and manual effort. Build and run Kubernetes environments (EKS) and deliver self-service capabilities to development teams through platform tooling and an internal developer platform (for example Backstage). Lead infrastructure modernisation, including OS migrations, tooling upgrades and reducing configuration drift across environments. Manage the software and dependency lifecycle, including security patching, vulnerability management, open-source component updates and RPM package management, with a clear inventory of platform dependencies. Maintain organised, versioned and accessible artefacts and packages through repository tooling such as JFrog Artifactory. Define and apply monitoring, alerting and observability standards (for example Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana) so issues are found and understood before they affect users. Act as subject-matter expert in diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure and configuration incidents, running root cause analysis and putting preventive measures in place. Partner with Platform Managers and development teams to understand their needs and deliver solutions that work, helping to bridge development and operations. Mentor junior engineers and write and maintain clear documentation to support continuous learning and engineering best practice. Key Qualification Requirements What you'll need for this role Experience level: 6+ years in infrastructure engineering, configuration management and automation, including significant hands-on experience with Linux systems and AWS cloud. Core Technical Requirements Configuration management: Strong hands-on expertise with open-source Puppet, including writing, testing and maintaining modules using roles, profiles and Hiera. Experience with module testing and release workflows (for example rspec-puppet and puppet-lint) is essential. Working experience with Ansible (playbooks, roles and inventory management) is also required. Certificate management and rotation: Hands-on experience managing the certificate lifecycle, including issuance, renewal, rotation and expiry monitoring, using internal or public certificate authorities and tooling such as AWS Certificate Manager. Ability to automate rotation safely across Linux, load balancer and Kubernetes environments. AWS cloud: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating AWS platforms, especially EC2, with a good understanding of IAM, S3, VPC and networking (for example Transit Gateway and Direct Connect). AWS Systems Manager: Practical experience using SSM for configuration and state management (State Manager, Run Command, Patch Manager, Parameter Store and automation documents). Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform. Terragrunt or equivalent tooling is a plus. CI/CD and DevSecOps: Experience designing multi-stage CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab (or Jenkins or GitHub Actions), with good knowledge of security practice such as secrets management, vulnerability scanning and compliance. Linux administration: Strong experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Rocky Linux 9 or equivalent, including systemd, SELinux and security hardening. Scripting: Strong Python and Bash skills for automation. Go is a plus. Packaging and artefacts: RPM package management and building, with experience administering RPM repositories and artefact repositories such as Artifactory or Nexus. Containers and Kubernetes: Working experience administering Kubernetes (EKS preferred), including networking, RBAC, pod security and Docker image management. Service mesh (Istio) is a plus. Observability and reliability: Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools (Honeycomb, Prometheus and Grafana) and defining alerting standards. Networking and architecture: Strong network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, traffic management and troubleshooting) and a good grasp of microservices and cloud architecture patterns. Software lifecycle and security: Experience managing security patching, vulnerability management and dependency hygiene. Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS is advantageous. Version control and collaboration: Proficient with Git (GitLab, GitHub and Bitbucket), able to work autonomously and contribute to engineering standards across teams. The Perks It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. full_description: #JLLTechAmbitions JLL, an international real estate management company, is building AI into the way its teams work with enterprise data. Build RAG and agent solutions with Amazon Bedrock: implement foundation-model integrations, Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails, and manage prompts and model selection for cost, latency, and quality. Build on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP): develop in the AIDP Workbench using Master Catalog assets, Spark notebooks, and workflows; apply medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data patterns; and build knowledge bases and agent flows on governed enterprise data. Build on Oracle AI Database: implement AI Vector Search, hybrid (vector + relational) retrieval, Select AI natural-language-to-SQL interfaces, and in-database ML, with embedding pipelines and PL/SQL where needed. Integrate across platforms: connect Oracle data services with AWS-hosted AI applications through secure, well-defined APIs and swappable service interfaces. Engineer retrieval quality: own chunking and embedding strategy, metadata filtering, reranking, and retrieval tuning, and measure results with repeatable evaluations. Secure and govern AI: apply IAM least privilege, database-enforced access control (such as role-based access and data redaction), PII handling, and guardrails that screen for prompt injection and unsafe output. Keep audit trails of agent actions and outcomes. Test and evaluate: build evaluation and regression suites for LLM output, track hallucination and accuracy, and verify behavior end to end against real services, not only with unit tests. Deploy and operate: ship Python services (for example FastAPI) to production on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and Secrets Manager. Monitor latency, quality, and cost with CloudWatch and AgentCore Observability. Collaborate and document: take part in sprint ceremonies and code and design reviews, and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer material. Experience & Education 4-8 years of software, data, or AI/ML engineering experience, with hands-on delivery of generative AI or LLM-based applications in production or near-production. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is preferred. Proven experience building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, including tool calling and multi-step orchestration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native deployment. Hands-on AgentCore experience is strongly preferred. Experience with Oracle Database or Oracle AI Database. Experience with the Oracle AI Data Platform is strongly preferred. Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, including tracing non-deterministic model behavior. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed team. Technical Skills & Competencies Generative AI on AWS: Amazon Bedrock foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt engineering, and model evaluation; Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability, and built-in tools such as Code Interpreter). Oracle data and AI: Oracle AI Database (AI Vector Search, Select AI, in-database ML, PL/SQL) and Oracle AI Data Platform (Master Catalog, notebooks, workflows, knowledge bases, agent flows, OCI Generative AI integration). AI application engineering: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), embedding strategy, chunking, reranking, and structured LLM output. AWS cloud: Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager. Programming: Python (primary), REST APIs, and SQL; FastAPI or similar async frameworks. Security and governance: IAM least privilege, data privacy controls, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails. Delivery: Agile/Scrum, Git and CI/CD, Docker, Jira and Confluence, and clear documentation. Preferred (Nice To Have) Experience with AgentCore Identity and Gateway for secure, tool-enabled agents. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Apache Spark, or medallion-architecture data pipelines. Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and Kubernetes experience. Experience with agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, or with migrating Bedrock Agents to a code-first framework. Experience with LLM gateways, token and cost tracking, and usage analytics. Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI certifications.

VuNet is Series B funded, part of NASSCOM DeepTech Club, awarded NASSCOM’s AI Gamechanger, recognized in Forbes DGEMS 200 and by several global analysts including Gartner, Omdia. We’re building a new category of observability purpose-built for complex digital journeys — across payments, lending, core banking and more — already powering some of the largest banks in India and MEA. Your Role: Lead - Platform & DevOps We are looking for a hands-on Platform & DevOps Lead to own and evolve the engineering platform on which VuNet products are built, released, deployed and operated. This role brings together our Platform and DevOps capabilities. VuNet runs across a mixed operating model: customer-managed on-premise environments, private cloud deployments and an increasing SaaS/cloud footprint. The engineering challenge Is therefore not only to operate infrastructure reliably, but to make installation, upgrades,releases and platform operations repeatable across very different environments. Today, some of this work still requires significant involvement from Platform, CARE and engineering teams. One of the key objectives of this role is to progressively make the platform self-sufficient, automated and supportable so that Customer Success teams, and eventually Qualified implementation partners, can perform standard installations and upgrades without deep Platform involvement. This is a lead engineering role, not a coordination role. You will remain handson, work through difficult production and platform problems, provide technical direction to the team and build stronger engineering capability across Kubernetes, CI/CD, automation, reliability and cloud operations. As VuNet expands its SaaS and Cloud operations, this role is expected to grow in scope and can evolve into broader Platform leadership. Are you excited to be a part of VuNet's trailblazing team? Join VuNet and make a difference Roles & Responsibilities What You Will Own Platform Engineering Own the Kubernetes-based runtime platform used to deploy VuNet products across on-premise, private cloud and public cloud environments. Drive platform architecture, lifecycle management, upgrades, scaling, security, performance and reliability. Standardize environments and reduce customer-specific variations wherever possible. Build reusable platform capabilities instead of solving the same deployment and operational problems repeatedly. Customer Installation & Upgrades Own the engineering capability for installation, upgrades and platform lifecycle management across customer environments. Improve installers, upgrade tooling, environment validation, sizing, pre-flight checks, rollback and troubleshooting mechanisms. Move progressively towards self-service installation and upgrades. Enable Customer Success and implementation partners to handle standard deployments without requiring Platform engineers for every activity. Ensure difficult customer environments feed improvements back into the platform rather than remaining one-off operational fixes. DevOps & Release Engineering Own and evolve CI/CD and release engineering practices across the product. Build reliable pipelines for build, test, packaging, deployment and release. Drive GitOps, deployment automation and consistent release practices. Improve rollback, recovery, zero-downtime deployment and upgrade mechanisms. Work closely with Product Engineering and QA to improve release predictability and deployment quality. Cloud & Infrastructure Automation Build reusable cloud infrastructure patterns using Infrastructure as Code. Own provisioning and automation across compute, storage, networking, IAM and Kubernetes infrastructure. Support VuNet's move towards SaaS and private SaaS operating models. Over time, build the operational capability required for Cloud Ops and SaaS Ops. Reliability & Operations Establish strong operational practices for the platform. Own monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, infrastructure health and platform-level reliability. Lead investigation of complex infrastructure, Kubernetes and deployment issues. Drive high-quality RCA and ensure recurring incidents result in engineering improvements. Improve resilience, backup, recovery and operational readiness. Security Build security into the platform and deployment lifecycle. Own areas including Kubernetes hardening, RBAC, secrets management, container security, image scanning, vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security. Work closely with security teams to support BFSI customer and compliance requirements. Engineering Leadership Lead and mentor engineers across Platform and DevOps. Create clear primary and secondary ownership across critical platform capabilities. Reduce dependencies on individual engineers. Develop the team across Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, automation, troubleshooting and reliability engineering. Set technical direction while remaining close enough to the systems to step into difficult problems when required. Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, CARE, Customer Success and implementation teams. What You Bring Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production. Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture, networking, storage, scheduling, security, upgrades, scaling and troubleshooting. Experience operating Kubernetes across on-premise and/or private-cloud environments in addition to managed Cloud Kubernetes. Strong experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for complex containerized products. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. Strong understanding of Linux, networking, storage, containers and distributed system fundamentals. Production experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Strong scripting or programming skills using Python, Go, Bash or similar. Experience with monitoring and observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK or equivalent. Experience handling production incidents, RCA, capacity planning and infrastructure reliability. Experience supporting installation and upgrades of enterprise software across multiple customer environments. Experience leading engineers while remaining technically hands-on. High agency: identifies meaningful problems, forms hypotheses, prototypes solutions, validates them against data and drives successful approaches into production without waiting for detailed task definitions. Certification Strong Kubernetes certification is preferred, especially CKA or CKS. Cloud DevOps / SysOps certification in AWS or Azure or GCP is strongly preferred. Certifications should be backed by meaningful production experience operating these technologies at scale. Good To Have Experience building internal platforms or self-service infrastructure capabilities. Experience with Helm, operators, GitOps platforms and Kubernetes lifecycle automation. Experience with service meshes, ingress controllers, API gateways and K8S networking. Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments. Experience with SaaS operations, SRE or cloud operations. Experience operating within enterprise security and compliance environments such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or CIS benchmarks. Experience working with implementation partners or enabling third-party teams to deploy enterprise products What Makes Someone Successful in This Role The strongest candidate will start with Why does this deployment require manual intervention? Can we automate this once instead of solving it separately for every customer? How do we make upgrades safe, repeatable and reversible? How do we reduce the amount of specialist knowledge required to operate the platform? How do we make the platform ready for a larger SaaS and cloud footprint? Where are the current operational dependencies and how do we engineer them out? You should be equally comfortable discussing Kubernetes architecture with a senior engineer and debugging a broken deployment with the team. You should be willing to challenge existing operational practices rather than simply inherit them. Why This Role Matters Today, enterprise deployments require engineering expertise across Kubernetes, infrastructure, product packaging, upgrades and customer environments. That model will not scale as the number of customers and deployment models increase. At the same time, VuNet is expanding towards SaaS and cloud-operated environments, which introduces a different level of expectations around automation, reliability, scalability and operational ownership. This role exists to bridge those two worlds: make enterprise deployments substantially more self-sufficient while building the platform engineering foundation required for SaaS and Cloud Ops. We’re a team of passionate problem-solvers who love tackling complex challenges. We learn fast, adapt quickly, and stay curious — especially when it comes to exploring and staying ahead of the curve with emerging technologies like Gen AI. More than just a tech company, VuNet is a place where collaboration, learning, and innovation are part of everyday life. We believe in working together, taking ownership, and growing as a team. If you’re looking to work on cutting-edge technology, make a real impact, and grow with a supportive team — you’ll feel right at home at VuNet. Transparent, Inclusive, and high-trust workplace culture. New Gen AI and integrated Technology workspace.
